installedCodeObservation.scope: Read-only executable bytes only. No CLI invocation, authentication/profile read or model/network request. Literal presence plus official SDK envelope is not an observed live missing-session response.

cases: Exact missing-session result before initialize leaves resume failing/timing out.
Exact missing-session result after initial resume prompt fails whole user turn.

implemented: An attempted saved resume/fork may recover once only if the exact typed root error identifies that owned session UUID and no output/tool/permission/background activity has occurred.

Required envelope: result/error_during_execution/is_error true, exactly one errors[] string equal to installed missing-session diagnostic plus requested UUID; no nested parent, malformed/non-human origin or nonempty result payload.
Old process is stopped; fresh launch is queued and bound to existing generation/owner/retained physical workspace. Root identity is revalidated before launch.
Fresh UUID is independent; same user turn ID and original remaining deadline are retained; canonical user/assistant history and current context/input are sent exactly once to the new session.
Generic transport, auth, quota, billing, network and arbitrary errors fail without replay. Partial output stays retained; any prior tool request blocks replay even if denied or auto-approved.
Cancel, shutdown, observer deletion or replacement after missing frame but before queued fresh launch suppresses obsolete retry. Fresh failure does not retry again.
Unchanged valid resume/live next turn and foreign owner/workspace policy remain unchanged.
intentionalDifferences: Pinned generic ACP runtime catches any resume failure and creates a session before prompting. Native direct Claude has no separate resume RPC: recovery is intentionally narrower and recognizes only a verified owned missing-session diagnostic, avoiding replay on account/transport/arbitrary failures.
If installed CLI changes diagnostic wording/envelope or emits only stderr/exit failure, recovery fails closed; it does not guess from prose substrings.
Partial-activity missing errors do not auto-recover because replay could repeat externally executed work. Original partial display is preserved.
